title: Time check and medical appointment
summary: Konitz has a medical appointment and they plan the remaining time.

blocks.x: Let’s go back to the late sixties, early seventies.
I thought we’d be in the two thousands by now.
We’re going be drifting around for a while.
We’re not going to get together again, right?
I had to make this appointment . . .
Do you have to be somewhere at four fifteen?
When do you have to leave?
. . . four I guess, or something like that.
Alright, [saying to Ken Kimery] Should we go until four Ken? Okay. I think we should be able to do some serious damage in the next hour.
[Laughing] I wish I could help you with it. It’s like I wasn’t there or something. I can’t remember all these dates and details.
